findings.text: quorum_without_persisting recognises the persisting incumbent by object identity (incumbent.func is workers._persisting_quorum_cycles), so any change to how workers.py:8990 wraps it - a decorator or a further partial layer - silently restores the canonical-row write this node's fix removes, and no test fails because the seam test constructs its own partial of the same shape rather than reading the call site.

store_panel_audit's graph write is stubbed in every test (write_reviews or GraphClient monkeypatched), so acceptance of the audit row by the StandardNameReview schema is unproven beyond the aggregate exclusion clause; the row follows the shadow-row shape at cascade.py:336 but omits the review_group_id that graph_ops.py:6050 documents as required for new-style reviews.
the module docstring says 'Three things keep the audit from deciding anything' above four bullets, because the non-persisting bullet was added in f86b0301c without updating the count.
